name: solve in each prime-power subgroup, then combine
mechanism: factor the group order, project the problem into each prime-power subgroup where it is small, solve it there, and combine the partial answers by the Chinese remainder construction

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Pohlig–Hellman algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms:

requires: a group of known, smooth order
fails_when: a large prime factor in the order leaves a hard subproblem
